messages.content: Hey, I just got out of the meeting with Boss Zhang about the Shenzhen trip. Turns out the weather forecast for the trip looks rainy, which is kind of a bummer.
Ah, that's annoying. Better remind the team to pack umbrellas! How did the rest of the meeting go?

Pretty standard. Boss Zhang asked if anyone had dietary restrictions for the Shenzhen trip dinners, so I'll need to send out a quick poll later. Also, someone joked that the hotel pillows for the Shenzhen trip are always too soft, which got a good laugh.
I can help you draft that poll whenever you're ready. Did you guys finalize the budget? Last time I checked, the cut was sitting at 15%.
Yeah, we finally nailed it down. Boss Zhang decided that the budget cut for the Shenzhen trip is finalized at 18% instead of 15%. We're going to have to get a bit creative with our expenses.
Ouch, an 18% cut is definitely going to require some belt-tightening. I'll update the budget tracker with the new target. Anything else you need me to note down?
No, that's the main conclusion from the meeting. Let's just make sure that 18% figure is locked in for the planning spreadsheet.
Got it. The 18% budget cut is locked and loaded. Let me know if you need help adjusting the specific line items later!

golden_memories: On 2025-09-08, Boss Zhang decided that the budget cut for the Shenzhen trip is finalized at 18% instead of 15%.

conversations.topic: Changing the pickup plan for the gift

messages.content: Hey, I need to update my reminder for Liwei's birthday gift. I know I previously said I'd get it Sunday, but I made a serious commitment to Liwei today that I'll pick up the Pixel 9 phone on Tuesday evening instead of Sunday morning.
Got it! I've updated the pickup time for the Pixel 9 phone to Tuesday evening. Anything else you need me to note down for the pickup?
Yeah, Liwei asked if the screen protector for the Pixel 9 phone comes pre-installed, so I need to ask them about that. We also discussed whether the charging cable for the Pixel 9 phone is braided.
Good call. I'll remind you to check on the screen protector and the braided cable when you're there. Ready to brave the mall?

Ugh, barely. The store layout for picking up the Pixel 9 phone is so confusing, I always get lost in there. But it's worth it, Liwei felt extremely excited about the Pixel 9 phone today because she has been waiting for the new camera features.
That's awesome! She's going to love testing out those new camera features. Just take a deep breath when you get to the store—you'll navigate it just fine!

golden_memories: On 2025-09-09, Linchen made a serious commitment to Liwei to pick up the Pixel 9 phone on Tuesday evening instead of Sunday morning.
On 2025-09-09, Liwei felt extremely excited about the Pixel 9 phone because she had been waiting for the new camera features.

messages.content: Hey, update my calendar. Jiange just texted me about next Tuesday's follow-up for the dentist appointment. He rescheduled to accompany me at exactly 11:30 AM instead of the original 10:00 AM slot.
Done. I've moved your dentist follow-up with Jiange to 11:30 AM next Tuesday. Anything else?
Not really, though I was just complaining to him about the parking fees near the clinic for the dentist appointment. They charge an arm and a leg!
Ugh, clinic parking is the worst. At least Jiange is driving you again.
Yeah. He's a weird guy though, he just asked me what flavor of mouthwash they use at the dentist appointment. Like, why would I know that?
Haha, maybe he's hoping for a nice mint instead of that weird medicinal flavor.
Probably. We also spent like ten minutes debating whether the waiting room magazines for the dentist appointment are actually updated. He swears they're all from five years ago.
He's probably right! Let me know if you need any reminders for the new 11:30 AM slot.

golden_memories: On 2025-09-10, Jiange rescheduled to accompany Linchen to the follow-up for the dentist appointment at exactly 11:30 AM next Tuesday instead of 10:00 AM.

messages.content: Hey, can you update my shopping list for the Shenzhen trip? I just got off the phone with Mom.
Sure thing! What are we changing for the trip?

Well, mostly she was just checking up on me. She asked how many t-shirts I packed for the Shenzhen trip, and then suggested taking a neck pillow because I mentioned the flight duration for the Shenzhen trip is about three hours.
Classic mom advice! A neck pillow is definitely a smart move for a three-hour flight. Did she want you to bring anything specific back?
Yeah, she actually changed her mind about the souvenir. I promised Mom I would buy her favorite specialty snacks during the Shenzhen trip instead of tea. Can you make sure I don't forget?
Got it. I've updated your reminder to buy her favorite specialty snacks instead of tea. Anything else you need me to note?
Nope, that's everything for now. Thanks!
You're welcome! Have a safe flight and good luck packing!

golden_memories: On 2025-09-11, Linchen promised Mom he would buy her favorite specialty snacks during the Shenzhen trip instead of tea.

conversations.topic: Testing the network for the broadcast

messages.content: Hey, I'm down at the venue right now. Wanghao and I were just discussing the seating arrangements in the main hall for the all-hands meeting.
Gotcha. Getting everything prepped for the broadcast? How's the network testing going?
Pretty good, we just finished the stress tests. Wanghao concluded that the live stream for the all-hands meeting will consume exactly 500 Mbps of bandwidth. So the network should hold up fine.
Awesome, that's a solid number to have. I'll make sure to note the 500 Mbps requirement. Anything else you guys need to figure out?

Not on the technical side. Mostly just gossiping now. Wanghao wondered if the CEO will wear a suit to the all-hands meeting, since he's been dressing down lately. Meanwhile, I just asked if there will be free pastries at the all-hands meeting. Priorities, right?
Haha, definitely priorities! Fingers crossed for the free pastries. Let me know if you need anything else before the meeting starts.

golden_memories: On 2025-09-12, Wanghao concluded that the live stream for the all-hands meeting will consume exactly 500 Mbps of bandwidth.

messages.content: Hey, I'm really freaking out today. I just realized I have to present my user-growth data to the entire company at the all-hands meeting later, and I'm extremely nervous about it.
Take a deep breath! It's completely normal to feel jittery before a big audience. Remember how much Boss Zhang praised your data presentation last month? You know this stuff inside out.

I know, but the scale of this is terrifying. To make it worse, I was just chatting with Sister Chen, and she mentioned she actually prefers the old slide templates for the all-hands meeting. Now I'm second-guessing the whole new deck I built.
Don't let that shake your confidence. Sister Chen might just be used to the old format, but your new charts are optimized and look great. Just focus on your delivery.
Delivery is another worry. Do you know if the microphone setup for the all-hands meeting is wireless? I tend to pace around a lot when my anxiety spikes like this.
I don't have the exact AV specs, but usually, the main stage has a wireless lapel mic. You can ask the tech team to hook you up with one so you can move around freely.

Good call, I'll ask them. Sister Chen and I were also just joking about the brand of bottled water provided at the all-hands meeting—it's always that weird, cheap tasting one. But honestly, with how dry my throat is getting from nerves, I'll probably chug three of them.
Haha, whatever keeps the vocal cords working! Try to do some quick stretches before you go on. You're going to crush this, Linchen.

golden_memories: On 2025-09-12, Linchen became extremely nervous about the all-hands meeting because he has to present his data to the entire company.

messages.content: Hey, I just wrapped up prep with Boss Zhang for the all-hands meeting. I'm still super nervous about presenting my data to the whole company.
You're going to crush it! Your data is solid. How did the prep session go?

Not bad. Boss Zhang noted the lighting in the room for the all-hands meeting is a bit dim, so we might need to adjust the projector brightness. I also suggested playing some upbeat background music before it starts to get people energized.
Upbeat music is a smart idea. It definitely helps break the ice before everyone settles in.
Yeah, we even joked about the awkward silences that usually happen at the all-hands meeting while people are waiting for it to start. Anyway, he also made a firm call on the agenda.
Oh? What's the final word on the agenda?
Boss Zhang decided that the Q&A segment of the all-hands meeting will be strictly limited to 15 minutes. So if people have extra questions, they'll just have to ping me offline.
Got it, a hard 15-minute cap on the Q&A. That should actually take some pressure off you. Anything else you need me to prep for the presentation?

golden_memories: On 2025-09-13, Boss Zhang decided that the Q&A segment of the all-hands meeting will be strictly limited to 15 minutes.

messages.content: Hey, I'm prepping for the all-hands meeting and it's driving me crazy. I have to complain—the required font sizes for these slides are ridiculously huge. I can barely fit my data in.
That sounds super frustrating! Giant fonts and detailed data charts definitely don't mix well. How are you managing to fit everything?

I'm just splitting the charts across multiple slides. I was actually talking to Jiange about the venue setup earlier. We discussed the color of the stage backdrop for the all-hands meeting—it's going to be a dark navy blue.
Dark navy blue is a solid background, it'll make your slides stand out nicely. Did Jiange have any good advice for the stage presence?
He mostly just asked if I bought a new laser pointer for the all-hands meeting. I haven't yet, but I probably should grab one so I can point out the metrics clearly.
A good laser pointer is definitely a pro move, especially with those massive slides! Are you going to do a dry run beforehand?
Yep, we just nailed down the time. Jiange scheduled to help me practice my presentation for the all-hands meeting at exactly 4:00 PM on Sunday.
Awesome, I've got it logged! Sunday at 4:00 PM practice run with Jiange. You're going to crush the presentation!

golden_memories: On 2025-09-13, Jiange scheduled to help Linchen practice his presentation for the all-hands meeting at exactly 4:00 PM on Sunday.

messages.content: Hey, I was just chatting with Wanghao about the Pixel 9 phone I finally picked up for Liwei. The unboxing experience was honestly super premium, way better than I expected.
Nice! I bet Liwei was thrilled, especially since she's been so excited about the camera features. Did Wanghao appreciate the premium feel too?

Yeah, though we mostly got sidetracked. Wanghao mentioned he really liked the grippy texture of the silicone case for the Pixel 9 phone, but then we spent like ten minutes debating the aesthetics of the camera bump. I think it looks fine, but he thinks it sticks out too much.
Haha, classic tech debate. Did you guys actually talk about how it performs for our app testing, or just critique the design?

We got to the performance eventually! We were analyzing how it handles our data-heavy dashboards. Wanghao ran some tests and concluded that the battery life on the Pixel 9 phone lasts exactly 18 hours under heavy load.
Wow, 18 hours under heavy load is seriously impressive. That pairs well with the 30% faster AI processing unit he benchmarked earlier this month.
Exactly. It's going to make our mobile user-growth testing much smoother without constantly reaching for a charger. Anyway, I need to get ready for my presentation practice with Jiange at 4 PM.
Sounds good! I'll note down Wanghao's battery benchmark. Good luck practicing for the all-hands meeting with Jiange!

golden_memories: On 2025-09-14, Wanghao concluded that the battery life on the Pixel 9 phone lasts exactly 18 hours under heavy load.

messages.content: Hey, I'm doing some final packing for the Shenzhen trip. We were just discussing the luggage weight limits for the flight. Can you remind me what the usual domestic allowance is?
Usually, it's 20kg for checked baggage and around 7kg for a carry-on, but it depends on your airline. Want me to look up your specific flight?

No need, I'll just weigh it. I just checked if I packed enough socks for the Shenzhen trip, and I think I'm covered. Liwei also asked about the subway route I'd take to the airport, so I need to map that out.
Got it. You can usually take Line 2 and transfer to the Airport Express, but mapping it on your phone now is your best bet. How's Liwei doing with you leaving?
Saying goodbye was actually a bit tough. Liwei felt a wave of sadness about the Shenzhen trip because it means we'll miss our favorite weekend market together.
Aw, that's totally understandable. Missing out on your regular traditions is hard. You'll definitely have to make it up to her when you get back!
Yeah, I plan to. Alright, I need to finish zipping up this bag and head out. I'll check in when I land.
Safe travels, Linchen! Talk to you when you touch down in Shenzhen.

golden_memories: On 2025-09-14, Liwei felt a wave of sadness about the Shenzhen trip because it meant they would miss their favorite weekend market together.
